Three glass beakers side-by-side representing the three states of matter to illustrate entropy. Left beaker (Solid): Blue particles neatly arranged in a tightly packed, regular grid at the bottom. Label below: "Solid (Lowest Entropy, Highly Ordered)". Middle beaker (Liquid): Blue particles loosely gathered at the bottom, slightly jumbled and disorganised. Label below: "Liquid (Higher Entropy, Disordered)". Right beaker (Gas): Blue particles spread far apart throughout the entire beaker, moving in random directions with short motion lines. Label below: "Gas (Highest Entropy, Highly Disordered)". Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
